thesis: TGTX is a profitable, fast-growing company in a confirmed uptrend that has held its post-earnings gains while the broad tech tape sold off. Q3 revenue grew about 61% YoY with a guidance raise, and the stock is above all key moving averages with strong relative strength. The setup is a pullback or retest entry in the 64.3-66.0 zone with a defined stop at 61.2 and a target of 72.7. A 27.7% short float adds squeeze fuel if the 68.03 high breaks on volume. The setup is decent but not high-conviction: the regime is risk-off, valuation is rich, and the breakout is not yet volume-confirmed.
